record.reason: The full text describes long-history ad recommendation infrastructure using retrieval, INT8 storage, and asynchronous serving, with low-latency production requests. It is a recommender system rather than an LLM inference/serving method; the Big Bird long-sequence lineage and use of RAG-style retrieval leave a possible but weak transfer connection.
record.title: Memento: Personalized RAG-Style Long-Retention Data Scaling for META Ads Recommendation
